record.body:
## Description

Fix the failure that blocked phase-end review: exclusive `dashboard-human-gate-writes` wording conflicts with preserved backlog promote/dismiss writes.

## Approach

1. Supersede active `dashboard-human-gate-writes` so the statement names the allowed dashboard write set without falsely excluding existing backlog promote/dismiss: include Needs-you human gates (displayed revision + notes) and backlog promote/dismiss (existing path), or equivalent clarifying language that matches phase Non-goals.
2. Do not restore blanket read-only. Do not change backlog.py behavior unless needed for statement accuracy.
3. Keep applies_to accurate. Acceptance: active constraint text covers both write families; old never-writes subjects stay retired.

payload.title: Clarify human-gate constraint vs backlog writes

record.subject: fix-human-gate-constraint
